title: Drawer
lede: Display content in a separate view from the existing context.

examples.heading: Default
examples.description: Only use a Drawer on small viewports. Shown here at any viewport for demonstration.

examples.heading: Custom height
Open
examples.description: The drawer open: the black 40% backdrop, the popup pinned to the bottom edge, full width, rounded at the top, its content scrolling inside it.

styles.decl: animation:show .4s var(--dialog-open-cubic-bezier) normal, content-fade-in .3s ease normal
animation:show .4s var(--dialog-open-cubic-bezier) normal, content-fade-in .3s ease normal
